yara (Design): quick sync: thinking about tightening the Account form UX. three decisions: 1) inline micro-errors vs single compact summary bar, 2) how to surface required fields (asterisk / 'Required' pill / sr-only text), 3) destructive confirmation for org delete (typed-confirm vs name-match vs countdown). attaching tiny prototype: https://drive.redwood.design/ux/account-compact-v5.png :eyes: mike (PM): my instinct: inline for small validation (format/length) so people can fix quickly. show compact summary only on submit when there are multiple issues. for delete: typed-confirm for org-level. dina (A11y): inline-first ok but must be announced (aria-live polite for inline, assertive for summary). asterisk alone is ambiguous for assistive tech — use sr-only "required" text or aria-required. For typed-confirm, ensure motor-accessible options (not just tiny text inputs). leo (Frontend): implementation notes: inline on blur/typing is straightforward. summary bar should be role=alert with anchors to fields. small pattern we use: ```html
3 issues found
``` rafa (Eng): for deletes I prefer typed-confirm for org deletes (require exact slug). also add server-side idempotency and a 3s confirm-lock to avoid double submits. for item deletes, modal + toast undo is OK. kim (Design Ops): mobile density: inline messages can balloon the page. on small screens, use single-line errors and collapse lengthy explanations behind a help link. also consider progressive disclosure for advanced fields. yara (Design): proposed compromise: live inline hints/errors during editing for single-field rules; if user submits and there are 2+ errors, show a compact summary bar at top with up to 5 bullets and anchors. required marker: visible asterisk + sr-only "required" copy. delete flow: typed-confirm for org delete; for single items show modal + undo. dina (A11y): +1. nit: ensure error color contrast >= 4.5:1, and that summary links are focusable and keyboard-navigable. also ensure focus is moved to the summary on reveal, and then to the first field when user activates a link. leo (Frontend): edge-case: server-side validation (unique slug/email) may arrive after client fixes — show server error in summary and also attach to field via aria-describedby so SR users get context. we'll standardize server-error payload shape. rafa (Eng): additional idea: for very long forms, the summary could show a small badge count and a flyout with the full list so the header doesn't grow. that keeps the page compact. a11y-bot: auto-check: recommended items: role=alert for summary, aria-live for inline updates, sr-only required labels, focus management on reveal, color contrast check. mike (PM): copy tweak for delete modal: prefer short, direct: "Deleting this workspace is permanent. Type DELETE to confirm." make it action-first and short. yara (Design): okay next steps 1 I'll update the prototype with: inline-as-you-type + summary-on-submit interactions, sr-only required labels, mobile copy compression, and a typed-confirm variant in the delete modal. tagging @dina for audit after update. planning a quick sync tomorrow 9:00am. :calendar:
